We need to indicate number of C=O groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly we need to get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR? But we need number of carbonyl groups. Could use IR spectra tool to detect C=O stretch peaks (~1700 cm-1). But we don't have the molecule's structure. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon shifts (~190-220 ppm). But we need to count.

We need to decide which tool to use. Since we have no other info, we need to measure IR or carbon NMR. IR is cheaper? Both are similar cost. Use IR to detect carbonyl groups. Let's call ir_spectra.
